system.effect: You become Trained in this Lore. Use its this Constellation’s Proficiency Bonus for its checks. Each Talent here contributes to this Constellation’s rank and its Key Attribute.
system.description: You know a particular subject well enough to recognize what matters within it. Lore might concern a profession, faith, region, people, organization, historical period, creature type, or similarly focused field. Every Lore field has its own training and Constellation.
